record.body: R49 materially changed the frontier from a recombination graph with external-consumer realization as the weakest edge into an executable consumer-realization factory. The new frontier contains independently extensible dimensions for realization surfaces, verifier strategies, dependency-relief mechanisms, receipt strategies, resilience strategies, authority transitions, and exact repository targets. Pairwise, triple, four-axis, five-axis, consumer-bound, reversible-only, SELECT-safe, and cardinality projections are now reusable marketplace operators. Structural reachable region is 1125 plans per consumer / 3375 across the three seed subjects, explicitly not observed execution. Non-dominated next regions: (1) ggen exact-head generated adapter execution, (2) chatgpt-cloud-elixir exact-head generated adapter execution, (3) compatibility tensor across consumer runtime/toolchain constraints, (4) N-way realization planner, (5) verifier-fanout generator, (6) receipt/replay fanout generator, (7) broader exact-repository census, (8) dependency-relief selector, (9) predicted-vs-realized leverage calibration. Read-only TensorFlow remains a preserved failed write edge, not a graph failure.
